title: b7z9.16(c): wire DAO timing into C rpl node loop
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.16 (spec 09 14.2 R-09-017..019: initial 0-2s random after join; retry 4/8/16s exponential; refresh 900s). Wire lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_timing.c exports into the C rpl node runtime loop (find the DAO send site: lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/router.c or node loop; no caller exists today outside lichen/tests/rpl_dao_timing/main.c). Keep rpl_dao_timing constants as the single oracle. Add/extend a host-buildable CMake test (pattern: lichen/tests/rpl_dao_timing or tests/rpl_dodag) driving the loop with injected time asserting initial 0-2s window, 4/8/16 retries, 900s refresh. Build with the host CMake test path (no west needed). Independently landable; Rust and Python mirrors are sibling children.
close_reason: Landed by worker-6 (claimed; ec73d26a9b): the composite DAO TX loop (387fdc3ed5, already on main from beads-worker-1: lichen_rpl_dao_tx_loop with INITIAL/RETRYING/REFRESH/IDLE phases consuming the dao_timing oracle) now compiles and passes its full runtime suite. Fixes landed: (1) rpl_dao_timing.c lichen_rpl_dao_retry_timer_schedule_next tolerated NULL delay_ms (was -EINVAL, breaking the tx_loop callers which pass NULL — the arm/deadline still happen; NULL only suppresses the report); (2) test fixes — two lichen_rpl_dao_tx_loop_init CHECKs compared a nonzero int against bool, a missing static declaration of tests_run, an off-by-one in the rescheduled-refresh timeline assertion (t+1800100 IS the new deadline; the test polled one tick early), and the NULL-delay expectation updated to match the guard. Verified: native_sim rpl_dao_timing suite PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL (all assertions pass including initial 0-2s jittered window, 4/8/16s retries, 900s refresh, mid-retry success reschedule, exhaustion -> IDLE). This completes the (c) wiring: the loop drives the C node loop via lichen_rpl_dao_tx_loop_poll/on_send_result with injected time and scripted RNG, constants from rpl_dao_timing only.
